Building and bases

Separate respawn points instead of clustering them in one room

If your server allows several usable beds or sleeping bags, give them different jobs. One can be near protected backup equipment in the core; another can be nearer a safer exit for checking the situation outside. Keep a usable path between them. Avoid spawning directly in front of intruders or into blocked furniture.

Before relying on this layout, verify that each point can actually be selected and that you can use the nearby locks and supplies after respawning. If only one point is available, put it where you can recover safely and reach backup gear. Extra points are not worth blocking essential storage or movement.

A three-bed base shown by a creator is one design, not evidence that every server has the same placement limit, cooldown or respawn rules. Test those rules on your own server.
